routes.guidance: Choose exact full content or bounded ranges by total task cost; --json reports completeness, hashes and continuation.
Use --mode exact only for a known literal; hzr rgai is the semantic shorthand.
Writes are atomic and idempotent per file; a batch is not an all-files transaction.
Project is the default scope; global is only for durable user-wide facts.
Use --max-tokens to bound evidence and --no-memory when memory is irrelevant.
Default policy route; preserves shell grammar and selects managed filtering or tracked fallback.
Project builds are ordinary managed shell commands; hzr build is not a generic project-build wrapper.
Use only when requested, repository-required, or justified by regression risk.
Allowed reasons: binary, checksum, machine_protocol, complete_log, full_patch, or verbatim_source.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_context_plan
mcp_tools.purpose: Build bounded graph-first evidence for unfamiliar or cross-cutting work.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_search
mcp_tools.purpose: Find code by intent or by a known exact literal.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_recall
mcp_tools.purpose: Recall durable decisions, resolved errors, and prior context.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_get
mcp_tools.purpose: Read one exact memory ID after verifying namespace ownership.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_store
mcp_tools.purpose: Persist one durable fact or finished handoff, not ephemeral state.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_update
mcp_tools.purpose: Replace one superseded memory after namespace ownership is verified.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_forget
mcp_tools.purpose: Delete one invalid memory after namespace ownership is verified.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_memory_prune
mcp_tools.purpose: Preview or remove low-weight memories in one namespace.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_codec
mcp_tools.purpose: Explicit duplicate-paragraph transform or shadow measurement; not a default step for generated prose. Host delivery and economic credit remain unverified.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_read
mcp_tools.purpose: Read exact full or bounded batch content with total token budget, hashes and explicit continuation.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_write
mcp_tools.purpose: Apply confined atomic patch or create operations with typed CAS receipts.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_exec
mcp_tools.purpose: Run commands, or start/wait/cancel bounded background jobs through daemon policy and accounting.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_observability
mcp_tools.purpose: Return typed daemon, engine, capability, and workspace health.

mcp_tools.name: hzr_doctor
mcp_tools.purpose: Run desired-state diagnostics for the exact MCP workspace.
